problem: In a group of 2009 people, each pair of people shares exactly one common friend. Determine the smallest possible difference between the maximum and minimum number of friends any person in the group can have.

answer_text:
# Finding the Smallest Difference in Friendship Degrees

## Setting Up the Problem

I model this as a graph $G$ with $n = 2009$ vertices where edges represent friendships. The condition states that **every pair** of vertices (whether adjacent or not) has **exactly one** common neighbor.

For any two distinct vertices $u, v$: $|N(u) \cap N(v)| = 1$.

## Applying the Friendship Theorem

This is precisely the hypothesis of the **Friendship Theorem** (Erdős, Rényi, Sós, 1966), which states:

> *If a finite graph has the property that every two distinct vertices share exactly one common neighbor, then the graph is a **windmill graph** — a collection of triangles all sharing one common vertex (the "center").*

Since $2009 = 2(1004) + 1 = 2m+1$ with $m = 1004$, the unique graph satisfying our condition is the windmill $F_{1004}$: **1004 triangles sharing a single center vertex $c$**.

## Verifying the Windmill Graph Works

The graph has:
- **Center vertex** $c$: adjacent to all $2008$ other vertices
- **Leaf vertices** $a_i, b_i$ for $i = 1,\ldots,1004$: each leaf $a_i$ is adjacent to $c$ and $b_i$ (and vice versa)

Checking all pair types:
| Pair type | Common friend(s) | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Two leaves in same triangle: $(a_i, b_i)$ | $\{c\}$ | $1$ ✓ |
| Center and a leaf: $(c, a_i)$ | $\{b_i\}$ | $1$ ✓ |
| Two leaves in different triangles: $(a_i, a_j)$, $i\neq j$ | $\{c\}$ | $1$ ✓ |
| Leaf from different triangles: $(a_i, b_j)$, $i\neq j$ | $\{c\}$ | $1$ ✓ |

All pairs satisfy the condition. ✓

## Computing the Degrees

By the Friendship Theorem, this is the **only** graph satisfying the condition, so the degrees are uniquely determined:

- **Maximum degree:** The center vertex $c$ has degree $d_{\max} = 2008$ (connected to everyone).
- **Minimum degree:** Each leaf vertex has degree $d_{\min} = 2$ (connected to $c$ and its triangle partner).

## Result

$$d_{\max} - d_{\min} = 2008 - 2 = \boxed{2006}$$
